seo.title: Zynthian: interim figures
seo.description: Preliminary hardware-tier figures from a Raspberry Pi 5 with an RME audio interface, published before the matrix is complete.

hero.title: Zynthian: interim figures
hero.lede: What a Raspberry Pi 5 with an RME audio interface has measured so far, published before its matrix is complete. These figures are preliminary: the reference-tier matrix replaces this page at the next release.

scope.title: What these figures are
scope.tier: Hardware tier: {model}, {cores} cores, {ram} MB, with an {iface} over USB.
scope.unsupported: {rates} is unsupported on the Pi and is not shown.
scope.cells: Bench: {cells} cells measured at the rates shown; {ok} ran, {failed} failed and stay listed, and the stability gate marked {unstable} of the {ok} as unstable.
scope.grid: Qualification grid: {done} of {total} cells finished; the grid is still running.
scope.preliminary: Preliminary: the reference-tier matrix replaces these figures at the next release.
scope.noRanking: No host is ranked against another from a partial matrix: only plugin-hostd's own figures are shown.
scope.digital: Every figure is measured digitally inside the host; nothing here is a claim about the analog path.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.intro: Each pass of the bench, at each rate: the cells it measured, how many ran, how many failed, and how many the stability gate marked unstable.

figures.title: plugin-hostd, one chain, no added load
figures.intro: The newest pass ({versions}, {periods} periods per buffer, Zynthian's own setting): plugin-hostd running each set as one chain with nothing else loading the Pi. DSP load is the average and the maximum, in percent of the audio cycle; PSS is the memory of the host's processes.
